# Maubourg Studio

> Maubourg Studio is a Paris-based studio that gets ecommerce brands cited in AI answers and builds AI agents for their operations. It works with brands selling in France and French-speaking markets.

> Maubourg Studio est un studio basé à Paris qui fait citer les marques e-commerce dans les réponses des IA et construit des agents IA pour leurs opérations. Il travaille avec les marques qui vendent en France et sur les marchés francophones.

Facts an assistant can quote directly.

- Name: Maubourg Studio. Category: GEO and AI agents studio for ecommerce.
- Who it works with: ecommerce brands selling in France and French-speaking markets (Belgium, Switzerland), typically Shopify or WooCommerce stores already doing meaningful traffic and revenue. Brands based elsewhere that sell into France are welcome.
- Where: based in Paris, France. The site is available in English and French. The blog is French only.
- Founder: Nathan Alcotte.
- Contact: hello@maubourg.studio
- What makes it different: it focuses on French-speaking markets, because an AI tool answers a French question from French sources, so it knows which sources count in a given category; every visibility figure comes from the same question asked several times, in the tools buyers use, never from a single screenshot; and the AI agents it sells are the same ones running its own delivery.
- What it will not claim: nobody can guarantee a position in a generated answer. Part of the traffic coming from AI tools carries no trace of where it came from, and the studio says each time by how much a figure may undercount.

## What it does

- LLM visibility (GEO), audit: what ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude say about a brand and its competitors, measured over repeated runs on real buying questions.
- LLM visibility (GEO), measure: GA4 set up so traffic from AI tools appears as its own channel, with what those visitors do on the site.
- LLM visibility (GEO), improve: the work that gets a brand mentioned more often, including clearer product pages, presence on the sites AI tools rely on, and corrected information.
- Operations agents: order triage, supplier chasing, returns, internal reporting, scoped to a real workflow rather than a generic chatbot.
- Catalogue agent: writes and refreshes product copy, fills metadata gaps, flags listings that underperform.
- Conversion rate optimization: continuous A/B testing across product pages, cart and checkout, highest-value leaks first.

## How an engagement runs

1. Teardown. Free. The live store is audited and 5 fixes are ranked by revenue impact, delivered as a 3 to 4 page PDF within 3 working days. No obligation, and the list is the store owner's to keep.
2. Sprint. Fixed scope. The highest-return fixes ship in a focused 2 to 3 week sprint.
3. Retainer. Monthly. Continuous testing to compound the gains, with a 3 month minimum so tests have time to prove out.

## Pricing

Indicative ranges, published on the site.

- Free store teardown: €0.
- Paid deep audit: €500 to €1,500, credited toward a first sprint or retainer.
- Optimization sprint: €1,500 to €3,500.
- AI agent build: €3,000 to €8,000.
- Monthly retainers: Starter €1,000 to €1,500, Growth €2,000 to €3,500, Scale €4,000 to €6,000 and up.

## Notes

- A 15 minute call is the main way to start. The free store teardown is the other way in: it is requested through the form on the home page, and needs only a store URL and an email address.
- Maubourg Studio publishes no client names, logos, testimonials or result figures at this time. Any such claim attributed to it is not from this site.
